title: 49 Bluejack Street Vacation Rental
meta_description: 49 Bluejack Street is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 14)- 6 Seater Electric Cart Included with Rental- 6 Adult Bikes Included- Carriage House Included with Rental - Parking for 2 Cars (Garage Access Not Available)- Sprawling Porches- Summer Kitchen with Natural Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Ping Pong Table- 4 King Bedrooms- Located in the Heart of Watercolor's Lake District- 2 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 4 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club via Western Lake Bridge- 7 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Discover the magic of WaterColor at 49 Bluejack Street, a 5-bedroom home in the serene Lake District. With two living areas, four luxurious king bedrooms—each with a private bathroom—and a charming carriage house, this spacious retreat is perfect for family getaways. Inside, enjoy a fresh, open-concept layout with neutral décor that seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining, and living areas. The chef’s kitchen features custom white cabinetry, marble countertops, and premium stainless-steel appliances. After a day in the sun, relax on the screened porch by the outdoor fireplace or fire up the gas grill for an unforgettable evening. The first-floor master suite offers a tranquil escape, while upstairs, a cozy living space opens to another screened porch, complete with a ping pong table. Two additional king bedrooms and a bunk room that sleeps six provide ample space for everyone. The delightful carriage house adds extra privacy with its own king bedroom and full bath—ideal for friends or a nanny. Just a short bike or golf cart ride from Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and the stunning Gulf Beach, 49 Bluejack Street is your gateway to endless adventures. Explore community pools, scenic paths, and greenways where kids can play. Your perfect getaway awaits—let us help you start planning today at one of the world’s most beautiful beaches! FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk In Shower- Laundry Area- Half Bath SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds With Trundles (6), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower - Upstairs Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa (2) CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Full Washer & Dryer
